# Navigation Menu

Menus that open on hover and share one floating panel, so moving between triggers resizes and slides the same surface instead of opening a new popover.

```tsx
<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-72 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/analytics">
            <ChartBar />
            <NavigationMenuLinkText>
              Analytics
              <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Traffic, funnels, and retention</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
            </NavigationMenuLinkText>
          </NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/monitoring">
            <Gauge />
            <NavigationMenuLinkText>
              Monitoring
              <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Uptime and performance alerts</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
            </NavigationMenuLinkText>
          </NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/integrations">
            <Plugs />
            <NavigationMenuLinkText>
              Integrations
              <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Connect your existing stack</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
            </NavigationMenuLinkText>
          </NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Resources</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-56 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/changelog">
            <Sparkle />
            <NavigationMenuLinkText>Changelog</NavigationMenuLinkText>
          </NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/guides">
            <Rocket />
            <NavigationMenuLinkText>Guides</NavigationMenuLinkText>
          </NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink variant="bar" href="/pricing">Pricing</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuIndicator />
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add navigation-menu
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/navigation-menu/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  NavigationMenu,
  NavigationMenuList,
  NavigationMenuItem,
  NavigationMenuTrigger,
  NavigationMenuContent,
  NavigationMenuLink,
} from "@/components/ui/navigation-menu"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <NavigationMenu>
      <NavigationMenuList>
        <NavigationMenuItem>
          <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
          <NavigationMenuContent>
            <NavigationMenuLink href="/analytics">Analytics</NavigationMenuLink>
          </NavigationMenuContent>
        </NavigationMenuItem>
      </NavigationMenuList>
    </NavigationMenu>
  )
}
```

## Columns

For a wide menu, set `NavigationMenuGroup`s side by side, each under a `NavigationMenuGroupLabel`, and close the panel with a `NavigationMenuFooter` for the link to everything else.

```tsx
<NavigationMenuContent>
  <div className="w-[34rem]">
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
      <NavigationMenuGroup>
        <NavigationMenuGroupLabel>Platform</NavigationMenuGroupLabel>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/analytics">Analytics</NavigationMenuLink>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/monitoring">Monitoring</NavigationMenuLink>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/alerts">Alerts</NavigationMenuLink>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/dashboards">Dashboards</NavigationMenuLink>
      </NavigationMenuGroup>
      <NavigationMenuGroup>
        <NavigationMenuGroupLabel>Solutions</NavigationMenuGroupLabel>
        …
      </NavigationMenuGroup>
      <NavigationMenuGroup>
        <NavigationMenuGroupLabel>Developers</NavigationMenuGroupLabel>
        …
      </NavigationMenuGroup>
    </div>
    <NavigationMenuFooter>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/platform">
        Explore the platform
        <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
      </NavigationMenuLink>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/status" className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">
        <span aria-hidden className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success" />
        All systems normal
      </NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuFooter>
  </div>
</NavigationMenuContent>
```

## Featured card

`variant="card"` turns a link into a featured block: a `NavigationMenuLinkMedia` picture over its title and description, beside the rows. The whole card is the link.

```tsx
<NavigationMenuContent>
  <div className="grid w-[34rem] grid-cols-[1fr_15rem] gap-1">
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/docs">
        <BookOpen />
        <NavigationMenuLinkText>
          Documentation
          <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Guides and the full API</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
        </NavigationMenuLinkText>
      </NavigationMenuLink>
      …
    </div>
    <NavigationMenuLink variant="card" href="/customers/lumen">
      <NavigationMenuLinkMedia>
        <img src="/lumen-team.jpg" alt="" />
      </NavigationMenuLinkMedia>
      <NavigationMenuLinkText>
        How Lumen ships twice as fast
        <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
          One dashboard for every team, and a release each week.
        </NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
      </NavigationMenuLinkText>
    </NavigationMenuLink>
  </div>
</NavigationMenuContent>
```

## Category rail

A `NavigationMenuSub` nests a menu inside the panel: a rail of categories down the side and a pane that switches the moment the pointer reaches the next one, with no delay. Its `defaultValue` picks the pane that shows first.

```tsx
<NavigationMenuContent>
  <NavigationMenuSub defaultValue="engineering">
    <NavigationMenuList className="w-40">
      <NavigationMenuItem value="engineering">
        <NavigationMenuTrigger>Engineering</NavigationMenuTrigger>
        <NavigationMenuContent>
          <div className="flex w-72 flex-col">
            <NavigationMenuLink href="/monitoring">
              <Gauge />
              <NavigationMenuLinkText>
                Monitoring
                <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Uptime and latency by region</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
              </NavigationMenuLinkText>
            </NavigationMenuLink>
            …
          </div>
        </NavigationMenuContent>
      </NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuItem value="product">…</NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuItem value="marketing">…</NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuItem value="sales">…</NavigationMenuItem>
    </NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuSubViewport />
  </NavigationMenuSub>
  <NavigationMenuFooter>
    <NavigationMenuLink href="/solutions">
      See every solution
      <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
    </NavigationMenuLink>
  </NavigationMenuFooter>
</NavigationMenuContent>
```

## Icon tiles

`NavigationMenuLinkIcon` sets a row's glyph in a 32px tile. A brand logo keeps its own colours there, where a bare icon in a row is muted, so it's the pick for integrations and apps.

```tsx
<NavigationMenuContent>
  <div className="w-[32rem]">
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2">
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/integrations/github">
        <NavigationMenuLinkIcon>
          <GitHubLogo className="size-5" />
        </NavigationMenuLinkIcon>
        <NavigationMenuLinkText>
          GitHub
          <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>Link deploys to commits</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
        </NavigationMenuLinkText>
      </NavigationMenuLink>
      …
    </div>
    <NavigationMenuFooter>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/integrations">
        Browse all 120 integrations
        <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
      </NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuFooter>
  </div>
</NavigationMenuContent>
```

## Timing

A trigger opens after `delayDuration` (200ms), so a cursor passing over the bar doesn't flash every menu. Reach a sibling trigger within `skipDelayDuration` (300ms) and it opens at once.

```tsx
<NavigationMenu delayDuration={100} skipDelayDuration={500}>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-56 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/analytics"><ChartBar />Analytics</NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/monitoring"><Gauge />Monitoring</NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Company</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-56 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/about"><Rocket />About us</NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/careers"><Storefront />Careers</NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuIndicator />
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

## Without the shared panel

`viewport={false}` gives each trigger its own panel, opened under it. Switching closes one and opens the next, so reach for it only when the menus are far apart.

```tsx
<NavigationMenu viewport={false}>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-56 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/analytics"><ChartBar />Analytics</NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/monitoring"><Gauge />Monitoring</NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Resources</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <div className="flex w-56 flex-col">
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/changelog"><Sparkle />Changelog</NavigationMenuLink>
          <NavigationMenuLink href="/guides"><Rocket />Guides</NavigationMenuLink>
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

## Density

`density` on the root sets the row height of every link in the menu. The panel padding stays put, so the corners stay concentric in both.

```tsx
<NavigationMenu density="comfortable">…</NavigationMenu>
<NavigationMenu density="compact">…</NavigationMenu>
```

## API reference

NavigationMenu

The root. Forwards Radix's `delayDuration`, `skipDelayDuration` and `value` / `onValueChange`. `viewport` (default `true`) renders the shared panel; `density` sets the row height of every link.

NavigationMenuList / NavigationMenuItem

The row and each entry in it. An item holds a trigger and its content, or a single `NavigationMenuLink variant="bar"`.

NavigationMenuTrigger / NavigationMenuContent

The chip in the bar and the contents of its panel. The caret turns while the panel is open.

NavigationMenuLink

`variant`: `"row"` (default), a row in a panel; `"bar"`, a plain entry beside the triggers; or `"card"`, a featured block. `active` marks the current page. Wrap a title and a `NavigationMenuLinkDescription` in `NavigationMenuLinkText` for a described row.

NavigationMenuLinkIcon / NavigationMenuLinkMedia

A 32px tile for a row's glyph, where a brand logo keeps its colours, and the inset picture frame of a `card` link. Put an `<img>` inside the frame; it owns an `aspect-video` ratio you can override.

NavigationMenuGroup / NavigationMenuGroupLabel / NavigationMenuFooter

A labelled column of links, its small muted heading, and the panel's foot under a hairline. Each is optional: a group reads fine without its label, and a footer with nothing above it drops its rule.

NavigationMenuSub / NavigationMenuSubViewport

A menu inside a panel. The Sub holds a `NavigationMenuList` rail (vertical by default) and, after it, the viewport the active pane shows in. It forwards Radix's `defaultValue`, `value` and `orientation`.

NavigationMenuIndicator / NavigationMenuViewport

The tip that slides under the active trigger (optional, the list's last child), and the shared panel, which the root already renders.

## FAQ

### How is this different from DropdownMenu?

DropdownMenu opens on click and every instance is its own popover: right for a single menu, like a Navbar's Collections link. NavigationMenu opens on hover and shares one panel across every trigger, so crossing from one to the next resizes that panel instead of swapping popovers.

### Why doesn't a passing cursor open every menu?

delayDuration (200ms) waits before the first open. Once one is open, skipDelayDuration (300ms) lets the next trigger open at once. Both are props on the root.

### Where does the panel sit?

Under the menu, aligned to its start edge, and as wide as the open content. Give the content's wrapper a width (w-56, w-72) to size each panel.

### Can one bar mix these layouts?

Yes. Every trigger's content mounts into the same panel, so a Product menu in columns, a Solutions rail and an Integrations grid can sit side by side: moving across the bar resizes the panel from one layout to the next.

### Is it accessible?

Yes. Radix handles the keyboard: arrow keys move between triggers, Enter or Space opens, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
